# Filter to unique competitions and get the most recent date
unique_competitions = df[['Date', 'Competition']].drop_duplicates()
# Convert 'Date' to datetime for proper sorting
unique_competitions['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(unique_competitions['Date'], dayfirst=True)
# Sort by date descending and get the last (most recent) competition's date
last_competition_date = unique_competitions.sort_values('Date', ascending=False).iloc[0]['Date']
# Format back to original string format (day first)
answer = last_competition_date.strftime('%d %B %Y')
